testimonials.title: People who took their finances into their own hands

items.name: Aga
items.quote: OurMoney is an app that makes agreeing on shared finances easier than deciding who walks the dog on Saturday morning. Highly recommend — and waiting for the dog-negotiation app too ;)

items.name: Daniel
items.quote: OurMoney is a simple and transparent tool for couples who want to effectively control shared expenses and plan future investments. Recommended for anyone who values organized, transparent financial management.

items.name: Klaudia
items.quote: OurMoney is literally — our expenses in one place. Easy to use, clear for tracking purchases, and with huge potential for tracking more and more financial aspects. Great for anyone who wants to start monitoring their cashflow better.

items.question: Do we both need to have the app?
items.answer: Not at the start! One of you can try the app first, and when you're ready — invite your partner and start using it together. This way you get 100% out of it without needing both of you on board from day one!

items.question: Is the app free?
items.answer: The app is completely free — no credit card, no limits. When we introduce paid plans, existing users will be the first to know and will get special terms.

items.question: How does expense splitting work?
items.answer: You can choose from four options: 50/50 split or proportional to income (e.g. 60/40 if one of you earns more). OurMoney automatically calculates who should contribute what. You can also track without a set split, or use a predetermined budget.

items.question: Does the app work on iOS and Android?
items.answer: OurMoney is a Progressive Web App (PWA) — it works on any device through the browser. You can add it to your home screen just like a native app. One account, access everywhere!

items.question: Will our data be secure?
items.answer: Privacy and security are our top priority. We apply the highest standards of data protection.

meta.title: About | OurMoney
meta.description: Meet the team behind OurMoney — the app helping couples manage shared finances without arguments.

hero.headline: We build bridges where money builds walls
hero.description: We believe finances in a relationship don't have to cause arguments. We created OurMoney to turn "unspoken frustrations" into fair partnership.

mission.title: Why we built OurMoney
mission.description: At OurMoney, we don't just manage expenses. Our goal is to create a world where money stops being a source of conflict and becomes a tool for building a shared future.
mission.story: We both have our own relationships, but share a common problem — finances as a couple is a challenge. It's not about lack of money. It's about the lack of a tool that truly understands how finances work for two. So we built OurMoney — the solution we were looking for and couldn't find.

members.name: Jakub M. Fedoszczak
members.bio: Developer with a passion for solving problems. In his own relationship, he discovered that finances for two require better tools.

members.name: Magdalena Nestorowicz
members.bio: Interface Designer. She knows that talking about money in a relationship doesn't have to be hard — you just need the right approach.
